reason: A Tauri desktop launcher for starting and managing a local DSH web service, viewing its logs, and opening local or remote DSH addresses in an embedded WebView.

summaries.zh: 用于在桌面端一键启动和管理本机 DSH Web 服务，并在内嵌窗口中打开本机或远程 DSH 地址。
summaries.en: A desktop launcher for starting and managing a local DSH web service and opening local or remote DSH addresses in an embedded window.

capabilities: Launches the local @deepseek-ai/dsh web service through npx
Displays local or user-specified remote DSH web pages in an embedded WebView
Streams child-process stdout and stderr to an in-app terminal
Runs as a system-tray application and manages the launched child process
